mapper.sql:
i.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.spec, i.item_type, i.proc_type, i.unit_cd, i.lot_ctrl_yn, i.net_mass_kg, i.hs_cd, i.remark, i.use_yn, i.std_price, i.row_ver, i.updated_at, i.updated_by,
(select x.external_id from mst_ext_id_map x where x.entity_type = 'ITEM' and x.use_yn = 'Y' and x.internal_id = i.item_id and x.system_id = (select s.system_id from mst_ext_system s where s.system_type = 'ERP' and s.use_yn = 'Y' order by s.system_cd limit 1)) as erp_item_cd

order by
i.item_cd i.item_nm i.item_type i.proc_type i.use_yn i.updated_at
desc,
i.item_id
mapper.select: select from mst_item i where i.item_id = #{id}
select exists (select 1 from mst_item where item_cd = #{itemCd} and item_id <> #{exceptId})

select exists (select 1 from mst_bom where item_id = #{itemId}) or exists (select 1 from mst_bom_line where item_id = #{itemId}) or exists (select 1 from mst_unit_conv where item_id = #{itemId} and use_yn = 'Y') or exists (select 1 from prd_wo where item_id = #{itemId}) or exists (select 1 from inv_trx where item_id = #{itemId}) or exists (select 1 from sal_order_line where item_id = #{itemId}) or exists (select 1 from lot_master where item_id = #{itemId})
select exists (select 1 from sys_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = #{unitCd} and use_yn = 'Y') or exists (select 1 from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = #{unitCd} and use_yn = 'Y')

insert into mst_item (comp_cd, item_cd, item_nm, spec, item_type, proc_type, unit_cd, lot_ctrl_yn, net_mass_kg, hs_cd, remark, use_yn, std_price, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.itemCd}, #{f.itemNm}, #{f.spec}, #{f.itemType}, #{f.procType}, #{f.unitCd}, #{f.lotCtrlYn}, #{f.netMassKg}, #{f.hsCd}, #{f.remark}, #{f.useYn}, #{f.stdPrice}, #{by}, #{by}) returning item_id
mapper.update: update mst_item set item_nm = #{f.itemNm}, spec = #{f.spec}, item_type = #{f.itemType}, proc_type = #{f.procType}, unit_cd = #{f.unitCd}, lot_ctrl_yn = #{f.lotCtrlYn}, net_mass_kg = #{f.netMassKg}, hs_cd = #{f.hsCd}, remark = #{f.remark}, use_yn = #{f.useYn}, std_price = #{f.stdPrice}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where item_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{f.rowVer}
update mst_item set use_yn = 'N', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where item_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer}
